## Migration Plan

### A. Files to copy/extract into execution-core

Low-hanging fruit — types only, no runtime risk:
1. `AttemptState` from execution-kernel/types.ts → already re-exported
2. `AttemptEventType` from execution-kernel/types.ts → already re-exported
3. `StateAuthorityToken` from execution-kernel/types.ts → already re-exported
4. `AttemptRow, AttemptEventRow, AttemptTransitionRow` from execution-kernel/types.ts → already re-exported
5. `LeadDirective, UserEscalation` from core/lead-agent/types.ts → already re-exported

### B. Files to wrap with execution-service facades

1. PlanControlManager's stop/continue/rerun → via execution-service command-handler
2. Web-server stop/continue endpoints → via execution-service command-handler

### C. Files to migrate imports now (low risk)

1. `execution-core/index.ts` — already re-exports from execution-kernel types
2. `execution-service/index.ts` — already re-exports from execution-core (our code)
3. brain boundary files — already import from execution-core (our code)

### D. Files to keep as legacy compatibility shims

1. `core/autonomous-executor.ts` — keep backward-compat WorkspaceAgentExecutor path
2. `execution-kernel/` — keep as-is during transition
3. `index.ts` — keep re-exports for backward compat

### E. Files explicitly not safe to move in P40.1

1. `execution-kernel/transition-router.ts` — deeply coupled to DB/Postgres
2. `execution-kernel/state-writer.ts` — deeply coupled to state store
3. `execution-kernel/attempt-fsm.ts` — deeply coupled to FSM transitions
4. `core/state-store.ts` — IStateStore interface, would break imports everywhere
5. `core/completion-gate.ts` — P37-stabilized, not safe to touch
6. `core/execution-gauntlet/**` — test infrastructure, keep as-is
7. `packages/db/**` — separate package
8. `packages/ai/**` — separate package
9. `packages/web-ui/dashboard/**` — separate app
